method:
Native loopback-origin persistence smoke test.

This is a bounded browser smoke test, not a device or performance test. It uses
an isolated temporary Chromium profile and a deliberately labelled synthetic
state change solely to exercise the production save path.

checks.name: Loopback response matches exact current HTML
Loopback page loads exact current HTML
M opens Map on native origin
C opens Character on native origin
Production save writes real loopback localStorage
Fresh browser relaunch retains loopback localStorage
Realm state reload retains authored note
